messages:
maria_pm: Heads-up — we're kicking off a small integration with FoldGate (gateway vendor) + LangChain/LlamaIndex to validate an adapter and prepare a cloud marketplace listing. Need to align on compatibility matrix, SI integration scope, and joint announcement timeline.

aj_devrel: Love it. Can we get a partner sandbox by EOW? we'll need sample notebooks, quickstart, and env vars.

kai_partnerships: Looping in partner outreach — I'll ping FoldGate for logos + security questionnaire. @maria_pm do we want them to sign the standard partner MSA before pilot?

sam_engineer: For the adapter checklist: auth (token vs mTLS), streaming semantics, function-calling hooks, and retriever compatibility for LlamaIndex. Also want to run a 512-token latency sweep.

ellen_seq: I started a compatibility matrix doc — linking here: https://docs.google.com/example (private). Minimums: LangChain v0.7+, vector store adapter API, and a 1k-token streaming smoke test.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: partner sandbox env created: pa-sandbox-3 — credentials DM'd to aj_devrel and sam_engineer.

maria_pm: Timeline proposal: dev validation by Apr 25 (2 weeks), SI pilot May 10, marketplace listing May 20, joint blog/announce May 27. Questions or blockers?

aj_devrel: Timeline looks ok but gating items: perf (p50 <250ms for 512 tokens on our default model) and a retriever+tooling example notebook that shows end-to-end flow.

sam_engineer: I'll own the perf harness and run the sweep. Will provide results and logs. Quick prototype command I'll use:

```bash
# simple latency runner
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"model":"redwood-std-1","input":"repeat(300)"}' \n    https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate | jq -r '.latency'
  sleep 0.2
done
```

sam_engineer: I'll containerize that and push to the partner repo.

kai_partnerships: I'll draft the partner playbook + marketplace copy. Need to confirm SLA level and support routing — do we want a dedicated Slack channel for the SI pilot?

maria_pm: Yes, dedicated channel makes sense. Assigning action items: sam -> perf harness + initial results by Apr 18; aj -> sample notebooks + onboarding notes by Apr 20; kai -> marketplace draft + ask FoldGate for logo and security questionnaire this week. I'll schedule a 30m sync for Thurs.

aj_devrel: :thumbsup: noted. Any NDAs or legal redlines to be aware of for the announcement?

ellen_seq: Legal confirms standard partner MSA covers pilot. Press/marketing collateral needs 3 business days review before publish.

maria_pm: Great — I'll book the sync and loop in marketing/legal in the calendar invite. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
